Volumetric Clouds URP (https://github.com/jiaozi158/UnityVolumetricCloudsURP, MIT) - patched for Unity 6000.6 / URP 17.6

Changes made to the original (May 2025) source:
- VolumetricCloudsURP.cs: removed the 6 legacy Compatibility Mode methods
  (OnCameraSetup(cmd, ref RenderingData) / Execute(context, ref RenderingData) in the 3 passes).
  URP 17.6 no longer has these base methods; Unity 6 uses the RecordRenderGraph path that is already in the file.
- Both .asmdef files: dropped references to GUIDs that do not exist in this project
  (Unity.Mathematics is now built into the engine).
If Unity ever reports errors from this folder after an update, this folder can simply be deleted
(also remove the Volumetric Clouds renderer feature from PC_Renderer and the override from the volume profile).
